summary: First-run comprehensive testing of LOCAFACIL. Backend: 29/29 pytest tests passed covering auth (login/logout/register), vehicles list/filter/create, privacy (plate mask + coord coarsening for public vs owner exact), booking flow with 12% split pricing math, mock split payment, checkin/checkout with payout_status=released, chat sanitization (phone + email masking + flagged=true), admin metrics + commission update + verify vehicle, and role-based access control (403 for renter/owner on admin, 403 for renter on POST /vehicles). Frontend: Home, Search (grid+Leaflet map view with price pins), vehicle details, register/login for all 3 roles, booking creation, mock payment, chat with phone-masking, admin dashboard, owner dashboard — all functional.

ui_bugs.issue: Category/transmission/price filter clicks only update local state — no auto-fetch. User must click 'Aplicar filtros' to see filtered list. useEffect deps array is [] so filter changes are not reactive. Expected UX per review spec: 'Applying category filter narrows results'. Recommend adding filters to useEffect deps or debounced auto-apply.

action_items: (Optional UX) Make Search filters auto-apply on change — currently requires clicking 'Aplicar filtros'. Add `filters` (or its serialized query) to the useEffect dependency array in /app/frontend/src/pages/Search.jsx (line 179).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 891 lines — consider splitting into routers/ (auth, vehicles, bookings, admin, chat) for maintainability.
Auth cookie is set with samesite=none + secure=true (correct for cross-site cookies over HTTPS). Uses bcrypt ($2b$) — verified.
public_vehicle() correctly masks plate and coarsens lat/lng deterministically for non-owners; owner/admin get exact coords — verified via test.
sanitize_message correctly redacts phone and email patterns and sets flagged=true — verified.
Mock split payment stores commission/owner_amount and marks payout_status=scheduled → released after checkout — verified.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout expectation). Not currently required by spec but recommended.
CORS uses CORS_ORIGINS env or '*' fallback with allow_credentials=True — with credentials, '*' is invalid; ensure CORS_ORIGINS is explicitly set in prod.

Frontend: 401 console errors on public pages come from /api/auth/me being called before login (AuthProvider). Not user-visible; consider silencing 401 in interceptor or checking cookie presence first.
seed_data_creation: Seed creates admin + locatario (KYC approved) + proprietario + 8 vehicles across BR cities + commission=12%. Verified via metrics: 9 vehicles active (8 seeded + 1 TEST_ created during owner-create test), 6 users, GMV populated after e2e booking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (29 tests, pytest-xdist safe, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Booking fixture creates real data in DB with TEST_ prefix — cleanup not implemented but non-blocking. Frontend end-to-end flow (search → detail → book → pay → chat) verified visually. Known UX quirk: Search filters require clicking Aplicar filtros to fetch.
rca of the issue: Search filter appears inert on click: root cause in /app/frontend/src/pages/Search.jsx line 179 — `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` with empty deps means changes to filters state don't refetch. `applyReload=load` is only invoked via the 'Aplicar filtros' button. Fix: change deps to `[filters]` (with debounce) or dispatch load from each setFilters. Backend supports all filters correctly.
